guidance.title: FC 1.000 Gathering feedback to improve procurement outcomes. Collecting voluntary feedback
guidance.excerpt: FC 1.000 Gathering feedback to improve procurement outcomes. Collecting voluntary feedback on the acquisition process supports continuous learning, better results, and improved outcomes over time. Just as important is sharing what’s been learned to improve processes across the Federal acquisition workforce. Agencies should gather feedback on the acquisition process of their procurements to help identify what went well and where improvements are needed. This feedback may be obtained using approaches including, but not limited to surveys (e.g., Acquisition360), team retrospectives, and conversations with offerors and contractors. The information can be used by the acquisition team, the agency, or governmentwide, as appropriate, to enhance the acquisition system.
